description: Header file providing pybind11 support for converting Eigen tensors, including helper functions, type casters, and support for Eigen::TensorMap and Eigen::TensorFixedSize types.

classes.name: eigen_tensor_helper<Eigen::Tensor<Scalar_, NumIndices_, Options_, IndexType>>
classes.description: Helper for Eigen::Tensor types, providing shape retrieval, shape validation, allocation, and deallocation.

classes.name: eigen_tensor_helper<Eigen::TensorFixedSize<Scalar_, Sizes<Indices...>, Options_, IndexType>>
classes.description: Helper for Eigen::TensorFixedSize types, providing shape validation, allocation, and deallocation.

classes.name: get_tensor_descriptor<Type, ShowDetails, NeedsWriteable>
classes.description: Provides tensor metadata description for pybind11 type casting, including details about contiguity and shape.

classes.name: type_caster<Type, ValidType>
classes.description: Pybind11 type caster for Eigen tensors and tensor maps, supporting conversion to and from NumPy arrays.

methods.name: is_tensor_aligned
methods.description: Checks if tensor data pointer is aligned according to Eigen default alignment.

methods.name: compute_array_flag_from_tensor
methods.description: Determines array flag (C-style or F-style) based on Eigen tensor layout.

methods.name: get_shape_for_array
methods.description: Converts Eigen::DSizes to std::vector for array shape.

methods.name: cast
methods.description: Various overloads for casting Eigen tensor types to pybind11 arrays, handling ownership and reference policies.
